ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RunWithAI uses your location to track your running routes in real time.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RunWithAI uses your location to track your running routes, even when the app is running in the background during your run.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: RunWithAI uses motion sensors to improve distance calculation and step counting during your runs.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: RunWithAI uses your health data to display heart rate and calories during runs.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: RunWithAI saves your runs to Apple Health.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: RunWithAI uses the camera to take pictures for your profile.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RunWithAI uses the microphone for voice commands during runs.
